action.mutates: on the peer: installs samba, creates the local account p8testuser (no login shell) with the fake Samba password p8test-share-not-a-secret, adds a read-only share [p8share] at /srv/p8share holding p8test-share.txt, restarts smbd

installs cifs-utils (mount.cifs, which desktop installs carry); adds the fixture sudoers drop-in /etc/sudoers.d/p8test-shares (0440) letting p8testuser run exactly the template's sudo commands (mount.cifs, umount) without a password, as a desktop user's own sudo rights would; runs the mount script as p8testuser with a wrong $PASSWORD; output in /tmp/p8test-mount-bad.out (its kdialog error dialog fails: no kdialog on GNOME)

action.mutates: runs the mount script as p8testuser with the right $PASSWORD (its sudo mounts the share; sudo logs to the journal and /var/log/auth.log); output in /tmp/p8test-mount.out
runs the unmount script as p8testuser (its sudo unmounts the share; sudo logs to the journal and /var/log/auth.log)

outcomes.outcome: the mount and unmount scripts are on the user's Desktop, root-owned and executable, rendered with the shares and options
run as the user with the right password, the mount script mounts the share, private to the user, with the server's files readable; a wrong password mounts nothing and fails
the unmount script unmounts the shares it lists
the password asked in a kdialog box and the file manager opened on the mount (explorer)

uncovered.why: the dialog waits for typed input and the file manager opens in the user's desktop session; a run sends no desktop input, and a session runs in a set's base run only
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: input injection into the node's desktop session inside a run
uncovered.evidence: the fixture sets explorer False and passes the password in $PASSWORD (the script asks kdialog only when it is empty); the runner's session logs the user in and makes agent runs, and sends no keyboard or mouse input

outcomes.outcome: symlinks to the mounts, and the cache and delay options

uncovered.why: parameter variants no production node uses (the fixture keeps the defaults)
uncovered.evidence: diagnosis/fleet_variant_usage.md (2026-11-23): no production node statement sets symlinks, cache or delay, and no class of the repository sets them on mount_shares_desktop
